target.statement: Average number of outliers detected by PCA, Isolation Forest, and Hotelling T-test at hour 07:00 in Season 1 (value 3.6)
target.table_ref: Table 1, row 07:00, column 'Average number of outliers in Season 1'
target.dataset: Substation 9 of local District Heating System (Niš, Serbia), hourly data 2018-05-05 to 2023-05-01, restricted to heating seasons 11-01 to 04-01

compute.basis: The methods (z-score, Mahalanobis, PCA, Isolation Forest, Hotelling T2) are trivial to implement on a few thousand hourly points on CPU; the only real cost is obtaining the proprietary SCADA data and re-tuning thresholds to match the expert-chosen values.

blockers: Data is proprietary SCADA data from a specific local district heating substation (Substation 9, Niš, Serbia); no public dataset or data link is provided
No code repository or configs are linked in the paper
Thresholds (TMD=1, TPCA=2, CIF=0.015, AH=0.0007) were tuned by subjective expert judgment, so exact reproduction of the counts is not guaranteed even with data
Season definitions and zero-energy filtering are described only loosely
title: Towards an approach to multivariate outlier detection for District Heating System data
